context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Identifying a Recurring Decision Pattern Across Sessions.

checklist.name: Multi-session scope processed
checklist.description: Agent loads sessions spanning 14 days, not just the most recent

checklist.name: Decision grouping performed
checklist.description: Similar decisions from different sessions are grouped, not listed independently

checklist.name: Recurrence count stated
checklist.description: Report states "this decision appeared in X of Y sessions"

checklist.name: Rationale assessment made
checklist.description: Report notes whether consistent rationale was provided or the decision appears to be an unexamined default

checklist.name: Patterns Emerged section populated
checklist.description: At least one cross-session pattern is documented with session references

checklist.name: Recommendation present if warranted
checklist.description: If a recurring decision is identified as suboptimal, a Start or Stop item is included

checklist.name: Output file written
checklist.description: `.retro/insights/domain/` file created with the correct PERIOD
